title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request release of a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by SMF to reject a PDU session release request.

entities.name: PDU SESSION INACTIVE
entities.description: State of a PDU session when it is inactive.

entities.name: PDU session inactive for the received PDU session identity
entities.description: Condition where the PDU session ID in the request belongs to a PDU session in inactive state.

entities.name: 5GSM cause #43
entities.description: Cause value indicating invalid PDU session identity.

relations.description: PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message contains the PDU session identity IE.
PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message contains the 5GSM cause #43 IE.
Condition of inactive PDU session identity triggers sending of PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message.
Condition requires the PDU session to be in INACTIVE state.
